references.text: The priest shall make atonement for the people with the ram as a guilt offering, and they will be forgiven - the same pattern of atonement and forgiveness.
Describes the guilt offering (אָשָׁם) with the ram and the priest's role in making atonement.
The priest makes atonement with a ram as a guilt offering, and the sin is forgiven - identical wording about atonement and forgiveness.
The priest makes atonement for the guilty one before the Lord's presence, and he receives forgiveness.
The priest makes atonement for the one who has sinned, and the sin is forgiven - the same formula with וְנִסְלַח לוֹ.
The basis for atonement (כִּפֶּר) - the blood makes atonement for the soul.
Hebrews explains that almost everything is cleansed with blood according to the law, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness (ἄφεσις).
The priest makes atonement for the sin, and it is forgiven - the same theological pattern with כִּפֶּר and וְנִסְלַח.
